ctx.x: In the New Yorker profile on Duke Ellington, Richard Boyer quotes you as saying when you were he was traveling with the band -- 'When we don't get sleep' -- We don't sleep, said Tizol, who was Puerto Rican and the only white man in the band, 'it seems like our lips get even stronger; you get a lot of sleep, and damn it if they don't crumble.' " Is that an experience that you remember?
